✅ New skills emerge at scale: folding towels, nesting paper cups, uncapping pens, arranging flowers
✅ Cross-embodiment transfer: G2-90D, under 2% of the training data, still gains 17.7 percentage points
✅ Failure data becomes a training asset — 2,000 hours of failed manipulations and deployment rollouts

A capable model envisions reality before it acts.
